examples.text: Het MRI-apparaat maakt veel lawaai. Daarom kun je een koptelefoon opkrijgen waardoor je ook muziek hoort.
examples.translation: The MRI machine makes a lot of noise. That is why you can get headphones through which you also hear music.
examples.english: The MRI machine makes a lot of noise. That is why you can get headphones through which you also hear music.

glosses: to get something to do, to be given something to do (such as an assignment)

examples.text: Veel kinderen weten niet wat er van hun verwacht wordt wanneer ze huiswerk opkrijgen.
examples.translation: Many children do not know what is expected of them when they get homework.
examples.english: Many children do not know what is expected of them when they get homework.

glosses: to eat up or drink up, to (manage to) finish a meal

examples.text: Nederland telt 5 miljoen 'kleine eters' die porties niet opkrijgen.
examples.translation: The Netherlands has 5 million 'small eaters' who cannot finish portions.
examples.english: The Netherlands has 5 million 'small eaters' who cannot finish portions.
